integrity: Derived from explicit spherical and beta-ball integrals; finite numerical tests are auxiliary and do not prove limits. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Dimension at least four. Fixed finite lambda crossover; local uniformity only on compact lambda intervals. The independent line sampling is conditioned motion-invariant Crofton sampling. Published ellipsoid chord moments are acknowledged and the cross-over is the claimed contribution.
title: Axis-coalescence crossover for long invariant chords of high-dimensional ellipsoids
